description: Treasure Hunter dialogue for Crystal Ascendancy quest - main merchant interactions

dialogue_lines._comment: ========== STEP 3A: Player has orb but merchant NOT housed ==========

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: If I had the proper facilities I could search my archives for more information.

dialogue_lines._comment: ========== STEP 3B: Player has orb AND merchant is housed ==========

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.
Ahh, here it is. An old parchment with the same script as your orb! It was donated to me by a trainer exploring in the oceans to the far South East of spawn.
I fear the temple is too difficult to enter without the aid of a pokemon. Come back to me when you have a pokemon that could help you.
Wonderful! One of your pokemon has dive. With their help you can enter the temple!
Here, take this map to the temple near where the parchment was found, you may be able to find a way to decipher them. I'll send my assistant to the temple to meet you there.
Best of luck on the journey to the temple! If you had the right pokemon you could get there much faster.
oh! You've got a pokemon with Teleport. They'll take you right there!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport to the Temple

dialogue_lines._comment: ========== STEP 3B RETURN: Player returns while still holding orb ==========

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: You've found the ancient tablet! Joyous day! I must have a look at it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Hmmmm... I can't quite make out any of the figures. Try to find a way to brighten up the text.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Glow Squid Ink, of course! Brilliant!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Hmmmm, I see I see. This is the translation cipher for the archaic script, it matches up perfectly with my parchment.
Here, take the old parchment, it may help you figure out the secrets of your orb.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: I've done all I can to help you, the rest is up to you <3.
